recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the FHIR spec reconciliation. If the warning still occurs, raise or test it in org.hl7.fhir.core with a validator case for Resource.language without Resource.text.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive Jira asked that the validator not warn that XHTML lacks a language tag when a resource has Resource.language but no Resource.text narrative.
initial_application: No FHIR-25192-tagged source commit was found in the current spec repository or on the combined reconciliation branch before this audit. Earlier history includes df47b32c6c, a pre-issue GF#18485 commit touching old validator language-tag tests and narrative wording for resources that do have narrative; that old Java validator implementation was later removed from this repository.
additional_context: The only later Jira comment says this is an old tooling issue and directs remaining problems to https://github.com/hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core. Zulip confirms the original report was an IG Publisher/validator warning for examples without narrative. Confluence searches found no contrary work-group record.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit because the requested false-positive warning behavior belongs to validator implementation outside the current FHIR spec checkout/build scope. The current spec source does not contain the reported warning text and its narrative/language guidance applies when narrative exists.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue asking the validator not to warn about missing XHTML language tags when Resource.language is set but Resource.text is absent.
evidence_items.learned: The final Jira request concerns validator behavior and has no specific current spec source artifact to edit.

evidence_items.summary: The reporter described the IG Publisher warning and asked whether it should appear when no narrative exists; Lloyd McKenzie answered probably not.
evidence_items.learned: The community discussion confirms the Jira was about tooling false positives rather than source prose needing clarification.

evidence_items.summary: Current narrative XHTML guidance says the div lang attribute should be used if language is declared on the resource.
evidence_items.learned: The current spec source addresses language tags for present narrative and does not impose the false-positive validator behavior reported for absent narrative.
